title: Door sill plates and scuff-prone trim
summary: Feedback on the G60 centers on door sill plates and side sill trim, combining requests for prior logo or illuminated sill features with comments about missing pieces and trim that scratches or scuffs easily.

positive.summary: Positive reviews ask for or highlight logo door sill plates and note the side sill trim design as easy to scuff, but the examples are too limited to show broader positive themes.

negative.summary: Negative feedback reports a missing door sill.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews note that illuminated door sills are no longer present and that door sill plates scratch easily from shoes without a clear overall judgment.

limitations: The sample is small, so examples are insufficient to establish broader patterns beyond the cited fragments.
The positive examples are somewhat heterogeneous, mixing a request for older logo sill plates with a scuff-prone trim observation.
Several fragments are brief and lack context on whether the comments reflect preference, complaint severity, or comparison with prior models.
